title: Move a ball with fixed-point coordinates
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge who are learning assembly
prerequisites: Signed word interpretation and full-width pointers
Saved-register calling conventions and publication boundaries
learningObjectives: Interpret signed words with eight fractional bits
Separate model state from display rounding
Publish initial and updated states coherently
Compare wrapped word arithmetic with an exact wider sum

progression.localImplementation: Native book, text microsteps, author-verified cumulative programs, and executable final-program CLI checks
